reference_decisions.transaction: all actions validate a copied state and commit atomically; rejected action leaves state and injected offers unchanged
reference_decisions.shop_offers: caller injects concrete offer instances; reducer checks only 81-row membership and tier ceiling, never claims historic server eligibility or stock
reference_decisions.shop_slot: each displayed instance carries a slot index; a purchase opens its slot, and refresh fills empty or unfrozen slots while frozen ones retain their positions
reference_decisions.freeze: shop-wide free toggle; each displayed instance stores a frozen flag; refresh retains frozen instances, next round retains them once then clears their flag
reference_decisions.refresh: pay 1, replace empty and unfrozen slots with caller-supplied offers, preserve frozen slots and visible positions
reference_decisions.new_round: unfrozen offers leave; frozen offers retain position once; refill supplied offers, reset coins to min(10, round+2)
reference_decisions.sell_coin_cap: sale adds 1 coin capped at 10 in this reference profile
reference_decisions.upgrade: reference displayed cost max(0, client_base_cost - skipped_rounds - hero_discount); successful upgrade consumes the hero discount and does not automatically redraw shop
reference_decisions.triple: after buy or discover creates a third normal instance, combine exact same definition IDs across board then hand into one reference golden hand instance; add permanent buff deltas and ordered attachments
reference_decisions.triple_reward: playing a golden from hand queues exactly one discovery for min(6, current_tier+1); candidate options are injected and checked only against study tier and uniqueness
reference_decisions.hand_limit: 10 as explicitly marked historical-rule reference assumption; board limit 7
reference_decisions.card_effect_dispatch: the reducer resolves bounded held-Zerus, Primalfin discovery, Megasaur adapt, and Coldlight Seer health-buff recruitment effects; other card effects, hero skills, simultaneous trigger priority, and shared stock remain outside this reducer
reference_decisions.zerus_tick: at the end of advance_round, after next shop and coins are prepared, each held BGS_029 source transforms once in hand order using a caller-supplied reference_injected index; the same instance remains eligible on subsequent round advances
reference_decisions.zerus_candidates: the ordered 80-ID index is historical-recruitment-zerus-candidates.json, derived from the 81-row study shop inventory without BGS_029; it is not a Blizzard candidate table
reference_decisions.zerus_form: normal or golden state is preserved as an explicit reference choice; golden candidates lacking an independent 35747 golden entity reject; printed target stats replace source stats, but existing buffs and attachments reject
reference_decisions.zerus_reward_and_triple: a pending golden triple reward stays on the source instance and queues once upon play; a transform that would make three same-definition normal cards, or any later triple consuming an active transformed Zerus, rejects because original merge timing is unverified
reference_decisions.zerus_exact_mode: a held source in exact_mode rejects atomically because candidate eligibility, weights, tick phase and golden state are unverified
reference_decisions.murloc_discover_condition: after a BGS_020 source enters the board, another MURLOC or ALL study card must be present; source alone does not qualify; ALL counting as Murloc is a reference filter
reference_decisions.murloc_discover_candidates: the ordered nine-ID index in historical-recruitment-murloc-candidates.json is a study subset, not Blizzard offer eligibility or probability
reference_decisions.murloc_discover_offers: normal source receives one three-distinct-index offer per battlecry and golden receives two; with exactly one normal/golden board Brann, two/three consecutive battlecry executions yield two/three/four/six offers; each caller injects option indexes, choice and reference_injected grade, with definitions allowed to repeat across offers; this nesting is reference-only
reference_decisions.murloc_discover_acquisition: each chosen option creates a normal hand card if space exists, then reference triple handling runs before the next offer; at full hand the option is shown but not acquired; no shared stock is mutated
reference_decisions.murloc_discover_reward_order: if a golden source also has a pending triple reward, play queues it before this bounded battlecry discovery; the other-Murloc condition and the single Brann source are sampled after placement; this ordering is reference-only
reference_decisions.murloc_discover_boundaries: an active exact-mode request, more than one Brann, or a Brann path whose source or sole other Murloc disappears before remaining offers rejects atomically; no-other-Murloc and non-source plays reject extraneous discovery input; original repeat and full-hand order remain unknown
reference_decisions.adapt_options: ten client-35747 option entities are an unverified reference candidate index; caller supplies three distinct indexes, a choice index, and reference_injected grade per prompt
reference_decisions.adapt_target_and_sequence: after a BGS_031 enters the board and any pending golden reward is queued, snapshot all friendly MURLOC and ALL study-card instances; normal has one option per battlecry and golden has two; with exactly one board Brann, its printed normal/golden repeat count makes two/three consecutive battlecry executions, each with its own one/two options; apply each injected choice to the same target snapshot; no target means no offer; this ordering is reference-only
reference_decisions.adapt_effect_state: each target carries a typed option/effect record and reference_injected grade; stat options also add printed permanent attack and health deltas; seven other option records are consumed by the bounded historical-combat-adapt-vectors.json bridge without claiming original server behavior
reference_decisions.adapt_reward_and_boundaries: a pending golden reward queues before adapt; exact mode, more than one Brann, malformed or missing prompts, forged grade, and a triple consuming adapted targets reject atomically; original offer eligibility, probability, Brann/golden order, and combat handoff are unknown
reference_decisions.coldlight_other_murlocs: after EX1_103 enters the board and any golden triple reward is queued, snapshot friendly MURLOC and ALL study-card instances except the source; each normal/golden battlecry adds permanent buff_health +2/+4 to those targets, excluding hand and shop
reference_decisions.coldlight_single_brann: one board Brann repeats that printed buff twice if normal or three times if golden; each repeat emits a separate reference_rule event after source placement, so normal/golden source totals are +2/+4/+6 or +4/+8/+12 per target without/with normal/with golden Brann; this order and ALL-race filter are reference-only
reference_decisions.coldlight_boundaries: two Branns with eligible targets or exact historic mode reject atomically, including placement and queued golden reward; no eligible other Murloc emits no buff event; original repeat timing, same-tick priorities, and combat handoff remain unknown
